about.title: Setlist Stats
about.intro: Setlist Stats is built from the sets you run and the songs you open in GraceChords.
about.rule: A set counts when you run it in Worship Mode while signed in: at least {{perSong}} minutes for each song, and never less than {{min}} minutes. A song counts when it’s on screen for {{seconds}} seconds or more.
about.private: Your stats are yours. No other GraceChords user can see them. Song counts across all users are added up anonymously to help decide what to build next.
about.control: You can clear your history or turn Setlist Stats off at any time.

preview.title: PREVIEW
preview.hint: Only admins and development builds see these switches.
